Messages.Author: Myrmidian
Messages.Body:
I'm wondering if the Legacy of Caine type of hunting still "counts" as
a hunt for purposes of The Hungry Coyote, Inbase Discotek, etc.

I don't know how you'd get LoC on one of your own vampires, but if it
did work with The Hungry Coyote, you could then add a Blood of the
Sabbat to the vamp and hunt for 3, if I'm thinking correctly.

Thanks in advance,
p.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Myrmidian <pha...@sfopera.com> wrote:
> I'm wondering if the Legacy of Caine type of hunting still "counts" as
> a hunt for purposes of The Hungry Coyote, Inbase Discotek, etc.
>
> I don't know how you'd get LoC on one of your own vampires, but if it
> did work with The Hungry Coyote, you could then add a Blood of the
> Sabbat to the vamp and hunt for 3, if I'm thinking correctly.

Legacy of Caine [SAB] - Master

* The amount gained (stolen) by the Legacy of Cain hunt action is
not affected by effects that affect the amount gained by
hunting (e.g., Aaron's Feeding Razor). [RTR 19970630]>
